name: List Events
description: Retrieve a list of event from the Google Calendar. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list)

configurable_props.name: calendarId
configurable_props.label: Calendar ID
configurable_props.description: Optionally select the calendar, defaults to the primary calendar for the logged-in user

configurable_props.name: iCalUID
configurable_props.label: iCal UID
configurable_props.description: Specifies event ID in the iCalendar format to be included in the response. Optional.

configurable_props.name: maxAttendees
configurable_props.label: Max Attendees
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of attendees to include in the response. If there are more than the specified number of attendees, only the participant is returned. Optional.

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: Maximum number of events returned on one result page. The number of events in the resulting page may be less than this value, or none at all, even if there are more events matching the query. Incomplete pages can be detected by a non-empty nextPageToken field in the response. By default the value is 250 events. The page size can never be larger than 2500 events. Optional.

configurable_props.name: orderBy
configurable_props.label: Order By
configurable_props.description: The order of the events returned in the result. Optional. The default is an unspecified, stable order. Must set Single Events to `true` to order by `startTime`.

configurable_props.name: privateExtendedProperty
configurable_props.label: Private extended property
configurable_props.description: Extended properties constraint specified as propertyName=value. Matches only private properties. This parameter might be repeated multiple times to return events that match all given constraints.

configurable_props.name: q
configurable_props.label: Query
configurable_props.description: Free text search terms to find events that match these terms in any field, except for extended properties. Optional.

configurable_props.name: sharedExtendedProperty
configurable_props.label: Shared Extended Property
configurable_props.description: Extended properties constraint specified as propertyName=value. Matches only shared properties. This parameter might be repeated multiple times to return events that match all given constraints.

configurable_props.name: showDeleted
configurable_props.label: Show Deleted
configurable_props.description: Whether to include deleted events (with status equals "cancelled") in the result. Cancelled instances of recurring events (but not the underlying recurring event) will still be included if showDeleted and singleEvents are both False. If showDeleted and singleEvents are both True, only single instances of deleted events (but not the underlying recurring events) are returned. Optional. The default is False.

configurable_props.name: showHiddenInvitations
configurable_props.label: Show Hidden Invitations
configurable_props.description: Whether to include hidden invitations in the result. Optional. The default is False.

configurable_props.name: singleEvents
configurable_props.label: Single Events
configurable_props.description: Whether to expand recurring events into instances and only return single one-off events and instances of recurring events, but not the underlying recurring events themselves. Optional. The default is False.

configurable_props.name: timeMax
configurable_props.label: Max Time
configurable_props.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's time to filter by. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp with mandatory time zone offset, for example, 2011-06-03T10:00:00-07:00, 2011-06-03T10:00:00Z. Milliseconds may be provided but are ignored. Must be greater than Min Time.

configurable_props.name: timeMin
configurable_props.label: Min time
configurable_props.description: Lower bound (exclusive) for an event's time to filter by. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp with mandatory time zone offset, for example, 2011-06-03T10:00:00-07:00, 2011-06-03T10:00:00Z. Milliseconds may be provided but are ignored. Must be smaller than Max Time.

configurable_props.name: timeZone
configurable_props.label: Time Zone
configurable_props.description: Time zone used in the response. Optional. The default is the time zone of the calendar.

configurable_props.name: updatedMin
configurable_props.label: Minimum Updated Time
configurable_props.description: Lower bound for an event's last modification time (as a RFC3339 timestamp) to filter by. When specified, entries deleted since this time will always be included regardless of showDeleted. Optional. The default is not to filter by last modification time.
